plan.reason: Paymentservice is a single‑replica critical service; a flaky network link to it should surface checkout failures and latency spikes, providing a stronger test than a simple pod kill which only shows availability loss.

replan_note: No prior network_loss experiment on paymentservice; this fault type distinguishes flaky dependency from outright pod failure and measures customer impact.
